purpose: Fail-closed construction rules for turning one exact Shine application release and its bounded review evidence into a pending_review Defence candidate.
candidateIdRule: candidateId is deterministic: appId plus '-' plus the first 12 hexadecimal characters of releaseCommitSha.
rules: Intake creates pending_review only; it never writes the reviewed ecosystem ledger, certification receipt, review decision or revocation state.
The candidate release SHA and profile blob SHA must be full lowercase 40-character Git SHA-1 identities.
Every claimed policy id must exist in the canonical Defence registry and policy ids must not repeat.
Evidence must contain 1 to 16 bounded non-secret records with source, kind, reference, checkedAt and summary.
At most one pending_review candidate may exist per app.
The exact release/profile/policy identity must not already exist in review-candidate history.
For an already reviewed app, repository and profile path must match its canonical app identity and the intake candidate must differ from the current reviewed release.
For a not-yet-reviewed app, prior candidate history may exist only for the same repository and profile path.
A deterministic candidate-id collision with a different identity fails closed rather than choosing another id.
Candidate intake does not validate the truth of external evidence; it validates structure, boundedness, canonical policy identity and queue consistency.
nonClaims: A pending candidate is not certification.
Candidate intake does not grant or extend the Protected by Shine Defence badge.
Recorded evidence is not independently verified merely because the intake helper accepted its shape.
Successful intake does not mean the release will pass review.
